prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Generate a new, truly transparent RGBA sprite sheet with ten separated pieces for a game paper-puppet NPC. Reference 1 is the exact young adult female character identity, subdued olive 1990s windbreaker, tied black hair, plum trousers, brown shoes and tan crossbody bag. Reference 2 is geometry/layout only; do not borrow the man's identity or clothes. Preserve the woman's face, age and color palette. Same height/scale and three-quarter facing right across all pieces. Exactly three rows on a landscape sheet: top row 2 pieces [head with neck and short low black ponytail; torso with collar, olive jacket, tan diagonal strap and attached tan satchel]; middle row 4 pieces [left upper arm sleeve with rounded shoulder tab; right upper arm sleeve with rounded shoulder tab; left forearm with cuff and hand; right forearm with cuff and hand]; bottom row 4 pieces [left upper trouser leg; right upper trouser leg; left shin with brown shoe; right shin with brown shoe]. Each piece is a single connected opaque silhouette, each has sufficient rounded hidden joint overlap, all have transparent gutters between every piece. No sample of a complete person, no extra props, no layout boxes, no text or numbers. A clean cut-paper silhouette with muted matte fibers and restrained highlights. No shadow outside the pieces, no solid background or visible checkerboard.
postprocess: The existing ten-part paper puppet binder with exposed light joint tabs matched to their adjacent cloth.
